title.suggested: Allen to Go to New Orleans for the Sullivan-Corbett Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch listed Tom Allen, America's ex-heavyweight champion, among the St. Louisans leaving Sunday morning for the Sullivan-Corbett fight in New Orleans, accompanied by his old backer Fred Watkins and friends.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Friday, September 2, 1892, page 3.

facts.fact: Allen was to leave St. Louis Sunday morning for New Orleans to see the Sullivan-Corbett fight, accompanied by his old backer Fred Watkins, Nobby Clark, Chris Lauff and Billy Dacre

notes: Allen is named in a long list of St. Louis delegates.
